# GoldTriEngine

> GoldTriEngine is an Expert Advisor (EA), a fully automated trading robot, for MetaTrader 5 that trades gold (XAUUSD). It is developed by Yelias, an independent developer. Its trades are streamed live on YouTube 24 hours a day, Monday to Friday, on a channel hosted by an animated AI robot that explains every trade, win or loss.

Key facts:
- Platform: MetaTrader 5 (MT5) on Windows, desktop or VPS. Not available for MT4.
- Market: gold (XAUUSD) only.
- Method: rule-based and algorithmic, with three independent engines called Alpha, Beta and Gamma. The AI is only the stream host; it never places, changes or closes trades.
- Risk: every trade has a stop loss. No martingale and no grid trading.
- Notifications: GoldTriEngine sends Telegram alerts to the user: EA start/stop, "EA offline detected" / "EA back online" heartbeat alerts, trades opened and closed, pending orders, drawdown alerts at chosen levels, risk-limit blocks, and a daily report. Each alert type can be switched on or off.
- Brokers: a Fusion Markets or IC Markets Raw account is required. GoldTriEngine is built, tested and supported only on these two brokers.
- Transparency: every live trade is shown on the YouTube stream; the track record (account type, deposits, balance, every trade) is on Myfxbook and in the live account section of the website.
- Backtest (MT5 Strategy Tester, simulated): GoldTriEngine v1.08 on XAUUSD, 1 Jan 2024 to 17 Oct 2026, Fusion Markets data, $5,000 start, 1:100 leverage: 1,302 trades, profit factor 2.00, 52.2% winning trades, average win 1.84 times average loss, largest relative equity drawdown 17.7%, 29 of 34 months positive.
- Live on YouTube since October 2026. The host is an animated AI presenter whose face reacts to each trade event; it explains trades but never tells viewers to buy or sell.
- Availability: yearly licenses are on sale now, priced by the account size you trade: Investor $1,000 (deposits up to $5,000), Tycoon $1,900 (up to $10,000), Mogul $3,600 (up to $20,000), Billionaire $5,000 (no limit). One license covers one MetaTrader 5 account in USD for one year and includes the EA, Telegram notifications, a setup guide, personal setup help and free updates during the license. Pricing page: https://goldtriengine.com/pricing.html
- Strategy rules are private; results are public.
- Risk notice: trading involves substantial risk of loss. Backtests are simulations and past results do not guarantee future results. Nothing published by GoldTriEngine is financial advice or a trade signal.
